pagerbot: :rotating_light: Coverage gap detected for APAC overnight window 02:00-08:00 UTC. Primary assigned: Maya R. No secondary currently scheduled for overlap 02:00-04:00 UTC. Auto-alert to #eng-oncall. Contact path: @oncall-shadow, @sre-lead. Please ack and confirm coverage or escalation plan. thread_ts=1738889999

Maya R: ack, saw the alert. I'm primary tonight but I have an unavoidable appointment 02:00-03:30 UTC (family), I can handle until 02:00 then need a shadow/secondary to be able to take any pages until 04:00. I can be reachable via phone but prefer someone to be PF'd. :pray:

Diego S: I can take secondary overlap 02:00-04:00 UTC, happy to cover. Is there a runbook for APAC overnight specifically? I might be mid-sprint but can step in. :wave:

Lena P: thanks Diego. runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/apac-overnight (internal). Key things:
- Primary responsibilities: triage 1st pager, check job queue health, validate model-serving pools in apac-region-1.
- Escalation: pager -> severity pagebot -> @sre-lead if >15m no fix.
- Customer impact thresholds: >5% 5xx rate or >30s p95 latency.

Lena P: Quick snippet from runbook (copy below)
```
Check GPU pool status: 
redwoodctl serving list --region apac-region-1
redwoodctl jobs tail --pool apac-primary --lines 200
If KV cache evictions > 10% in 10m -> consider fallback to cached model variant: set routing policy to model-variant:cached-v1
```

Diego S: got it, reading. Can someone post the current alert summary (error rates / customers affected)? I want to know if this is a pure coverage gap or there's active customer impact.

Maya R: no active customer-impact alert right now, just schedule gap detection. I did see a small spike in 503s for a partner integration earlier (EU region) but it auto-resolved after the fallback policy. Nothing ongoing for APAC that I can see. 

Omar K: FYI we have two big customers with APAC traffic on CIDs 5124 and 6180, they prefer direct contact if we're doing human handoffs. If Diego takes secondary, please loop in support with the handoff note.

Diego S: will do. I can be secondary 02:00-04:00 UTC. @Maya R — to confirm handoff: at 01:55 UTC you'll ping me in this thread and DM with any active context, and I will set myself as secondary in the console and run the quick health checks (below).

Maya R: yep will do. Handoff checklist (short):
- mark status in console: `oncall set-secondary --user diego.s --window 02:00-04:00`
- paste last 30m of relevant logs to incident channel if any errors
- DM support with customer stub for CIDs 5124/6180 if any active jobs

oncall-shadow: acknowledged. I'll be available as backup if both of you need escalation. If Diego gets a page you can't resolve in 15m, escalate to @sre-lead. :eyes:

sre-lead: noted. If this becomes a real incident (customers affected or >5% 5xx sustained), open an incident bridge and notify CS. For now it sounds like a schedule-only gap with volunteer cover. Thanks to Diego for stepping up.

Diego S: quick note on tooling: when taking secondary I run these checks immediately (to save time if a page comes in):
1) `redwoodctl serving status --pool apac-primary`
2) `promql "sum(rate(http_requests_total{zone=~\"apac.*\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (customer)"`
3) check `kv_cache_evictions` Grafana panel for >10%
If any of these are abnormal, escalate as per runbook.

Maya R: perfect. I'm going to add a short note in the shift doc and set an out-of-office note for 02:00-03:30 UTC pointing people to Diego as secondary.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledged volunteers. Diego S set as secondary for 02:00-04:00 UTC. Auto-updated oncall roster.

Diego S: set my phone to Do Not Disturb off for that window. also pinging support: support@redwood.com — sending handoff stub now.

Diego S: (to support) stub: "APAC overnight coverage: Diego S will be secondary 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. Customers 5124 & 6180 noted. No active incidents. Contact via Slack DM or phone +1-555-0123."

Maya R: thanks all — appreciate the quick cover. If anything changes I'll update this thread. If there are any residual customer-facing issues, we'll open an incident and follow the full runbook. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: closing auto-alert (coverage gap resolved) at 03:00 UTC based on secondary assignment. If anyone needs to reopen, react with :loud_sound: or @pagerbot reopen.

Diego S: leaving a short post-handoff note for runbook audit: "covered as secondary 02:00-04:00 UTC for Maya R due to short appointment. No pages received. Verified pool health at 02:05 UTC."

Maya R: added to shift notes and tagging CS to confirm customers got the stub. Good night all. :zzz:
